original_ai_output.title_zh: 苏丹准军事组织无人机袭击埃塞俄比亚边境附近，据称致41人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据人权组织“紧急律师”称，苏丹快速支援部队（RSF）周五对青尼罗州阿布尚迪地区一处流离失所者营地发动无人机袭击，造成41人死亡，据称其中包括8名儿童。联合国人道主义事务协调厅表示对相关报道感到震惊，初步报告显示伤亡者多为妇女和儿童。该事件目前为单一来源报道，具体伤亡数字尚未获得独立核实。

location.site: 阿布尚迪地区一处流离失所者营地
location.raw_text: the state's Abu Shandi area, Blue Nile region bordering Ethiopia

key_facts.fact: 苏丹快速支援部队（RSF）无人机袭击青尼罗州阿布尚迪地区一处流离失所者营地，据称造成41人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A drone attack by Sudan's paramilitary forces has killed 41 people in the country's Blue Nile region bordering Ethiopia, a rights group has said. The strike by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) targeted a camp for displaced people in the state's Abu Shandi area on Friday, Emergency Lawyers said.

key_facts.fact: 据称死者中包括8名儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Eight children are said to be among those killed by the strike, which hit a gathering of displaced people.

key_facts.fact: 联合国人道主义事务协调厅称初步报告显示伤亡者多为妇女和儿童
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The UN Office for the Co-ordination of Humanitarian Affairs (Ocha) said it was "appalled by horrifying reports". It said initial reports suggested most of the casualties were women and children.

key_facts.fact: 苏丹军方与包括RSF在内的准军事力量自2023年起持续权力斗争，已致数十万人死亡、逾1400万人流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Sudanese army and paramilitary forces including the RSF have been locked in a power struggle since 2023, a conflict that has killed hundreds of thousands and displaced more than 14 million from their homes.

key_facts.fact: 联合国人道主义事务协调厅称遭袭地区近几周持续遭受攻击，数千平民流离失所
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ocha said in a statement that the area reportedly struck on Friday had been "under sustained atttack in recent weeks, displacing thousands of civilians and exposing many more to grave harm".

uncertainties: 伤亡数字（41人死亡、含8名儿童）目前仅来自人权组织“紧急律师”的单一来源，尚未获得独立核实
袭击方为RSF的说法系人权组织指控，苏丹军方与RSF双方均被指使用无人机袭击
联合国方面称相关报道为“初步报告”，具体伤亡构成有待进一步确认
